title: review input (grouped)
description: Grouped action-parameter tool consolidating the review family (resolve, chain) into one MCP tool. The `action` discriminator selects the per-action body; each branch reproduces the exact per-action input schema (review.resolve.input.json / review.chain.input.json) with `action` added to its allowed properties. Per-action handlers and their behaviour are unchanged — this is a zero-functionality-loss consolidation.

action.description: Which review operation to perform. resolve: apply a policy bundle to a manifest, producing per-entity decisions + audit trail. chain: compose the four C5 surfaces (queue → resolve → conflict-detail → apply-summary) against a server-resident fixture.

manifest.description: Inline Object Catalog manifest object. Mutually exclusive with manifestPath.

manifestPath.description: Project-relative path to a manifest JSON file. Absolute paths and parent-directory traversal (..) are rejected.

projectRoot.description: Optional override for the project root used to resolve manifestPath. Defaults to process.cwd().

defaultAction.description: Decision applied when no policy matches an entity. Defaults to 'defer' so unmatched items surface for follow-up rather than being silently accepted.

fixture.description: Named server-resident Object Catalog fixture. Allow-listed at the handler — unknown names return OODS-RC-001.

reviewThreshold.description: Threshold below which entities are flagged for review by the queue and detail emitters. Default 0.7.

lowestSignalsN.description: Top-N selector for per-entry lowestSignals in the queue artifact. Default 3.

evidenceGapThreshold.description: Signal-level threshold used by conflict-detail to classify signal gaps. Default 0.5.

defaultAction.description: Decision applied by review.resolve when no policy matches. Default 'defer'.

policyBundle.description: Ordered policy bundle. First match wins per entity; no-match falls to defaultAction.

id.description: Optional bundle identifier echoed in the audit trail for reproducibility.

reason.description: Human-readable reason surfaced verbatim in the resolution when this policy matches.

predicateConfidenceThreshold.description: Match when entity.oods.confidence_decomposition.total < threshold. With matchUnknown=true, also matches entities with no confidence_decomposition.

predicateSignalTypeFloor.description: Match when a named signal's score < floor. Does not match when the signal is absent or when confidence_decomposition is absent.

predicateEntityUrnMatch.description: Match by entity URN. Provide exactly one of `urn` (exact string match) or `pattern` (glob with * and ?).
